summary: Iteration 9: Full backend + frontend testing of new Emergent-managed Google sign-in on /admin, plus password-login regression and protected-endpoint regression. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass and 5/5 frontend Playwright flows pass via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. No source modifications; only new test file added.
tests_executed: BE POST /api/auth/google/session {session_id:'bogus'} -> 401 {detail:'Invalid or expired sign-in session'}
BE POST /api/auth/login admin creds -> 200, both access_token and refresh_token cookies set with HttpOnly flag
BE POST /api/auth/login with wrong creds (non-existent email to avoid admin lockout) -> 401
BE GET /api/auth/me with cookie -> 200, returns admin user
BE GET /api/contact without auth -> 401; with auth -> 200 (list)
BE GET /api/finder/insights without auth -> 401; with auth -> 200
FE /admin: admin-login-page renders with email/password inputs, submit and admin-google-signin-btn ('Sign in with Google')
FE Google button click -> https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<encoded window.location.origin>/admin (route intercepted; assert exact URL and URL-encoded redirect param match)
FE /admin#session_id=bogus123 -> spinner then login card with admin-google-error text 'Invalid or expired sign-in session'; URL hash cleared to /admin (react-router replace)
FE Password login regression: form submit -> admin-inbox-page renders; admin-lead-count shows '3 leads'; Finder insights panel present ([data-testid*='finder'])
FE Sign out: admin-logout-btn -> returns to admin-login-page
FE Console errors: only 5x expected 401s from /api/auth/me pre-login probe (unauthenticated state); no unexpected JS errors
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::allowed_google_emails() reads ADMIN_EMAIL via os.environ[...] without a default; will KeyError at request time if the env var is ever unset. Consider os.environ.get('ADMIN_EMAIL','').lower() with a startup assertion, but not blocking today because backend/.env seeds it.

Admin.jsx line 231 uses window.location.hash directly inside the mount effect while sessionId is derived from useLocation().hash; both agree on first render so the flow works. If a future refactor moves the /admin route inside a Suspense or deferred boundary, this dual-read could diverge. Non-blocking.

google_session endpoint issues session cookies before returning UserOut but does not enforce role='admin' on the *stored* user (it uses user.get('role','admin'))—since access is already gated by allowlist this is safe, but a defensive `role='admin'` write on both branches would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin and existing 3 leads; no contact submissions this iteration (respecting rate limit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google sign-in surrounding flow fully verified (invalid session_id 401/422 behavior, encoded redirect URL, error surfacing on /admin, hash clearing). Real Google OAuth completion cannot be automated — allowlist logic path (403 for non-whitelisted emails) is only exercised by code review, not by an end-to-end request. Password login + protected endpoints regression is green. test_google_auth.py is safe to re-run repeatedly; wrong-password test uses a non-existent email to avoid tripping the 5-attempt admin lockout.
